occurrences.call: val content = request.submission ?.value(VexFamilyConversationScreen.MessageDraft) ?.trim() .orEmpty() if (repository == null || content.isEmpty()) { return@appAction } val attempt = synchronized(pendingLock) { val current = pending when { current == null -> PendingFamilyConversationSend(content = content, idempotencyKey = idempotencyKeyFactory()).also { formed -> pending = formed } current.content == content -> current else -> null } } ?: return@appAction scope.launch { sendMutex.withLock { try { val thread = refreshCurrentRoom() val family = thread.familyBinding ?: run { clearTerminal(attempt) return@withLock } when (repository.send(VexFamilyConversationSendRequest(threadRef = thread.threadRef, spaceRef = family.spaceRef, expectedChannelRef = thread.currentChannelRef, expectedMembershipGeneration = family .currentMembershipGeneration, idempotencyKey = attempt.idempotencyKey, content = attempt.content))) { is VexFamilyConversationRepositoryResult.Accepted, is VexFamilyConversationRepositoryResult.Rejected, -> clearTerminal(attempt) } } catch (error: CancellationException) { throw error } catch (_: Exception) { } } }
